name: Schloss Moritzburg
_about: SCHLOSS MORITZBURG, Augustus the Strong's baroque hunting lodge (Poeppelmann, 1723-33, round the Renaissance lodge) on its island in the Schlossteich, from OpenStreetMap's plan: the main body and the two wings between four round towers under red bells and white lanterns, the chapel risalit with its Dachreiter on the west, the Speisesaal risalit on the east; ochre walls, white lesenes and window surrounds, red mansards; the terrace with its balustrade, piers, vases and statues, the north and south ramps, the curved stairs down the lobes; the island with its guardhouses, walks, trees, boat landings, the bridges and the causeway. Inside: the vaulted entrance halls, the four great halls of the principal floor (Billardsaal, Steinsaal, Monstroesensaal, the Speisesaal with its antlers), the chapel and its gallery, the apartments, the towers' rooms, two dog-leg stairs (tools/archgen/moritzburg.py).
